title: Prompt Palette Curated Styles — Krea 2 & MOSS-Image

krea2.name: Krea 2 & Turbo
krea2.grammar: Cohesive natural-language prose (30–150 words). Start immediately with Subject or Scene (no meta-intros like 'A picture of'). Put literal rendered text inside "double quotes". Avoid comma tag soup, (weight:1.3) brackets, and buzzwords like 'masterpiece, 8k'.

params.turbo: 8 steps, CFG 1.0, Euler or er_sde / simple, ConditioningZeroOut (no negative prompt)

antiPatterns: Meta openings ('Generate an image of...', 'A photo of...')

moss.name: MOSS-Image (Base / SFT / Turbo)
moss.encoder: Qwen3.5-9B + FLUX.2 VAE (4D RoPE, up to 4000+ tokens)
moss.grammar: Three native dialects: (1) Caption: detailed descriptive English/Chinese prose with quoted literal text and \n breaks; (2) Ordered Tags: strict Quality -> Score -> Meta -> Year -> Character -> Series -> @Artist -> General -> rating:general hierarchy; (3) Spatial JSON: summary + items with abs_centralized yxyx bbox on multiples-of-16 canvas.

params.base: >= 50 steps, Euler / simple, CFG 3.0–6.0, Shift 5.0, SLG Layer 22 (scale 3.0), active negative
params.sft: 30–50 steps, Euler / simple, CFG 3.0, active negative
params.turbo: 4–8 steps, Euler / simple, CFG 1.0 (negative prompt bypassed at CFG 1.0)

antiPatterns: Omitting '@' before artist tags in Ordered Tag mode
Top-left xyxy coordinates passed raw without abs_centralized yxyx conversion

curated_mixes.name: Krea 2 · Direct-Flash Editorial
curated_mixes.description: Punchy 2000s campaign look combining direct flash hard drop shadows, cobalt/silver palette, mid-stride coat turn, and 35mm film grain.
curated_mixes.quotedSample: A fashion model caught mid-stride as they turn over their shoulder, long coat swinging dynamically, direct-flash photography casting a hard crisp drop shadow against a minimal studio backdrop, high-contrast cobalt blue and metallic silver palette, shot on 35mm analog film with visible silver halide grain.

curated_mixes.name: Krea 2 · Brutalist Material Study
curated_mixes.description: Monolithic concrete architecture paired with honed waterfall marble, soft north-window daylight, and a 24mm low-angle perspective.
curated_mixes.quotedSample: Monumental brutalist architectural pavilion of poured board-formed concrete, floor-to-ceiling glass wall framing an interior with honed waterfall marble and warm-grey stone podiums, soft north-window daylight washing across textured mineral surfaces, low-angle 24mm perspective emphasizing heroic scale and quiet spatial purity.

curated_mixes.name: Krea 2 · Solarpunk Botanical Craft
curated_mixes.description: Optimistic urban ecology combining handcrafted terracotta pottery, lush vertical garden hydroponics, natural golden hour rim, and 50mm eye-level framing.
curated_mixes.quotedSample: An artisan shaping terracotta clay at a wooden potting bench inside a sun-filled solarpunk botanical conservatory, lush vertical green walls with brass misting tubes in the background, warm low raking sunlight grazing across clay test tiles and hand-thrown planters, natural 50mm eye-level framing.

curated_mixes.name: Krea 2 · Analog Sci-Fi Flight Deck
curated_mixes.description: Tactile retro-futurist spacecraft interior with illuminated CRT monitors, amber-teal instrument dials, matte soft-touch plastics, and exact debossed lettering.
curated_mixes.quotedSample: The pilot cockpit of an analog interstellar freighter, instrument consoles packed with heavy physical toggle switches, amber phosphorescent flight dials and twin CRT displays reading "ORBITAL LOCK", practical cinematic amber and deep teal illumination, matte tactile switchgear, shot on 35mm film.

curated_mixes.name: MOSS · Studio Editorial Caption
curated_mixes.description: Natural descriptive English studio caption with shallow 85mm optical depth, calm contemplative subject, soft window daylight, and exact quoted typography card.
curated_mixes.quotedSample: An artisan in a quiet design studio sits beside a solid oak workbench, resting hands naturally while gazing forward with a calm contemplative expression. Soft natural window light pours in from the left, highlighting natural skin texture and linen fabric. Shot on an 85mm prime lens at f/1.8 with gentle creamy bokeh. A small ivory card on the desk reads "PROMPT PALETTE".

curated_mixes.name: MOSS · Ordered Booru SFW Key Visual
curated_mixes.description: Strictly ordered Booru tag sequence obeying OpenMOSS Quality -> Score -> Meta -> Year -> Character -> Series -> @Artist -> General -> Rating hierarchy.
curated_mixes.quotedSample: best quality, masterpiece, score_9, score_8_up, highres, absurdres, year 2024, 1girl, solitary traveler, @makoto shinkai, windblown scarf, overcast sky, volumetric clouds, train platform, distant mountains, looking at viewer, rating:general

curated_mixes.name: MOSS · Spatial JSON Exhibition Poster
curated_mixes.description: Structured 1024x1024 spatial JSON layout utilizing abs_centralized yxyx bounding boxes on a 16-divisible canvas for headline, visual object, and footer.
curated_mixes.quotedSample: {"summary": {"meta": ["poster"], "canvas": "single", "caption": "A graphic exhibition poster with a title at the top, a sculpted ceramic vase in the center, and date information in the footer."}, "items": [{"label": "text", "caption": "Bold uppercase sans-serif exhibition title", "text": "CERAMIC FORM", "bbox": [-448, -448, -272, 448]}, {"label": "object", "caption": "A minimalist stoneware vase with matte terracotta glaze on a pedestal", "bbox": [-200, -300, 320, 300]}, {"label": "text", "caption": "Small uppercase gallery details", "text": "PROMPT PALETTE GALLERY • 2024", "bbox": [384, -400, 464, 400]}], "bbox_coord_space": "abs_centralized", "bbox_format": "yxyx"}

curated_mixes.name: MOSS · Chiaroscuro Matte Painting
curated_mixes.description: Dramatic cinematic matte painting featuring classic Rembrandt triangle key lighting, deep rich atmospheric shadows, and wide panoramic landscape depth.
curated_mixes.quotedSample: Cinematic matte painting of an ancient cliffside observatory during a storm. A single shaft of warm lantern light breaks through tempestuous clouds, illuminating the central dome with a classic triangular chiaroscuro key highlight while the surrounding precipice falls into deep ink-blue shadow. Wide panoramic 24mm framing with atmospheric rain haze and deep volumetric depth.

styles.description: Builds a calming architectural atmosphere using natural mineral hues of clay, travertine stone, and warm concrete.
styles.whenToUse: Interior design portfolios, architectural monographs, slow-living editorials, and sustainable home product branding.
styles.antiPatternNote: Avoid fluorescent neon accents or intense digital oversaturation.

styles.name: Soft-Touch Cheerful 1990s Pop Palette
styles.krea2Phrase: cheerful 1990s pop palette, mint green, banana yellow, soft lilac and translucent neon coral plastics, bright even lighting, playful consumer design
styles.mossCaption: vibrant yet soft 1990s pastel pop color scheme, candy-colored consumer tech accents, playful optimistic palette
styles.conflictReason: Directly contradicts grim brooding desaturated palettes.
styles.description: Channels the playful consumer optimism of early iMacs and 1990s electronics through candy pastels and translucent colored polymers.
styles.whenToUse: Youth lifestyle campaigns, playful gadget concepts, candy packaging, and nostalgic product still lifes.
styles.antiPatternNote: Avoid gloomy dark shadows or rusted grunge textures.

styles.name: Krea 2 Spatial Word-Budget Ordering
styles.krea2Phrase: Order tokens strictly: [Immediate Subject & Action] + [Grounded Environment / Architecture] + [Lens & Framing] + [Directional Lighting Setup] + [Medium & Surface Physics] + [Atmosphere]
styles.mossCaption: structured natural language descriptive prompt with front-loaded subject hierarchy followed by environment, camera, and lighting specifications
styles.conflictReason: Conflicts with comma-separated Danbooru tag soup.
styles.description: Exploits Qwen3-VL's spatial word-budget mechanics: tokens placed first command immediate spatial and compositional priority.
styles.whenToUse: Constructing any high-fidelity Krea 2 prompt to enforce desired wide environmental or tight portrait crops.
styles.antiPatternNote: Never open with conversational filler ('Generate an image of') or append quality buzzwords ('8k, masterpiece').

styles.name: Exact Double-Quoted Typography Wordmark
styles.krea2Phrase: a prominent storefront sign that reads "OPEN 24 HOURS" in crisp embossed serif typography with clean readable glyphs
styles.mossCaption: a minimalist storefront sign reading "PROMPT PALETTE" in clean uppercase sans-serif typography, sharp and perfectly legible
styles.mossLayoutHint: label: text, text: "WORDMARK", bbox: [y0, x0, y1, x1]
styles.conflictReason: Unquoted raw words generate scrambled illegible glyphs.
styles.description: Commands the text encoder to render exact literal glyphs onto signs, bottles, or apparel by wrapping the phrase in strict double quotes.
styles.whenToUse: Storefront signs, brand packaging labels, book covers, graphic apparel, and poster typography.
styles.antiPatternNote: Do not omit double quotation marks; raw unquoted words are treated as abstract concepts rather than literal text.

styles.name: MOSS Natural Descriptive Caption Dialect
styles.krea2Phrase: natural flowing descriptive prose without comma-separated tag soup, rich in spatial prepositions, material physics, and optical details
styles.mossCaption: Detailed descriptive English prose specifying subject, setting, optical framing, directional lighting, and exact in-image quoted text strings
styles.conflictReason: Conflicts with Booru comma tag lists.
styles.description: MOSS-Image's primary natural language dialect, leveraging Qwen3.5-9B's deep comprehension of prepositions, adjectives, and optical physics.
styles.whenToUse: Complex narrative scenes, high-end commercial photography, subtle emotional moments, and multi-subject interactions.
styles.antiPatternNote: Do not spam random comma tags or SD-style bracket weights like '(cinematic:1.2)'.

styles.name: MOSS Tier 1 Quality Anchor
styles.krea2Phrase: photorealistic, highest fidelity visual clarity, clean sharp rendering
styles.mossCaption: best quality, masterpiece
styles.conflictReason: Must be placed in slot 1 of Ordered Tag mode.
styles.description: Slot 1 in OpenMOSS's strict 9-tier taxonomy. Anchors model attention to the highest-fidelity training distribution.
styles.whenToUse: The very first tags in any MOSS Ordered Tag prompt for anime or digital illustration.
styles.antiPatternNote: Never place quality tags at the middle or end of a tag sequence.

styles.name: MOSS Tier 2 Aesthetic Score Anchor
styles.krea2Phrase: award-winning visual aesthetic, pristine lineart, balanced color grading
styles.mossCaption: score_9, score_8_up
styles.conflictReason: Must be placed in slot 2 directly following quality tags.
styles.description: Slot 2 in OpenMOSS taxonomy. Filters against aesthetic scoring thresholds to ensure clean contrast and zero artifacts.
styles.whenToUse: Slot 2 in MOSS Ordered Tag sequences.
styles.antiPatternNote: Never use negative score tags like 'score_4'.

styles.name: MOSS Tier 3 Meta Resolution Anchor
styles.krea2Phrase: high-resolution rendering, crisp micro-details, ultra-clean edge definition
styles.mossCaption: highres, absurdres
styles.conflictReason: Must occupy slot 3.
styles.description: Slot 3 in OpenMOSS taxonomy. Activates high-frequency textural resolution and clean line rendering.
styles.whenToUse: Slot 3 in MOSS Ordered Tag sequences.
styles.antiPatternNote: Avoid combining with 'lowres'.

styles.name: MOSS Tier 4 Year Anchoring Tag
styles.krea2Phrase: contemporary modern visual production, contemporary anime key visual standards
styles.mossCaption: year 2024
styles.conflictReason: Must occupy slot 4.
styles.description: Slot 4 in OpenMOSS taxonomy. Anchors styling to contemporary modern art trends (e.g. 2024) rather than vintage 2000s archives.
styles.whenToUse: Slot 4 in MOSS Ordered Tag sequences.
styles.antiPatternNote: Scrambling the position into general tags degrades temporal anchoring.

styles.name: MOSS Tiers 5 & 6 Character & Series Hierarchy
styles.krea2Phrase: depicting the specific character with canonical costume, signature hairstyle, and official franchise aesthetic
styles.mossCaption: character_name, series_name
styles.conflictReason: Must precede artist and general descriptive tags.
styles.description: Slots 5 & 6 in OpenMOSS taxonomy. Establishes character identity and franchise lineage before applying artist modifiers.
styles.whenToUse: Directly following year tags when generating fanart or specific canonical characters.
styles.antiPatternNote: Do not put artist tags before character tags.

styles.name: MOSS Tier 7 @Artist Convention
styles.krea2Phrase: stylized with distinctive clean line weights, luminous lighting, and emotive character rendering
styles.mossCaption: @artist_name
styles.conflictReason: Requires '@' prefix in MOSS Ordered Tag mode.
styles.description: Slot 7 in OpenMOSS taxonomy. Requires an '@' prefix before artist names to trigger precise illustrator stylization.
styles.whenToUse: Slot 7 in MOSS Ordered Tag prompts when invoking specific illustrative styles.
styles.antiPatternNote: Never omit the '@' prefix in Ordered Tag mode (e.g. '@makoto shinkai' not 'makoto shinkai').

styles.name: MOSS Tier 9 Safe Rating Anchor
styles.krea2Phrase: clean tasteful family-safe composition, elegant public presentation
styles.mossCaption: rating:general
styles.conflictReason: Must terminate Ordered Tag prompts as slot 9.
styles.description: Slot 9 in OpenMOSS taxonomy. Terminates the prompt to anchor generation strictly within safe, public-friendly aesthetic distributions.
styles.whenToUse: The final tag of every MOSS Ordered Tag prompt.
styles.antiPatternNote: Do not omit or place at the beginning.

styles.name: MOSS Spatial JSON Layout Specification
styles.krea2Phrase: structured graphic layout with upper headline text, centered hero illustration, and bottom descriptive footer block
styles.mossCaption: {"summary": {"meta": ["poster"], "canvas": "single", "caption": "A graphic poster layout"}, "items": [{"label": "text", "caption": "Title", "text": "HEADLINE", "bbox": [-448, -448, -256, 448]}], "bbox_coord_space": "abs_centralized", "bbox_format": "yxyx"}
styles.mossLayoutHint: Summary object + items array with label (text|object|character), caption, and centralized yxyx bbox.
styles.conflictReason: Requires valid JSON syntax structure.
styles.description: OpenMOSS's spatial JSON schema mapping layout elements to abs_centralized [-512, 512] yxyx coordinate space.
styles.whenToUse: Posters, magazine covers, complex infographics, multi-figure compositions, and UI mockups.
styles.antiPatternNote: Never pass top-left [0, 1024] xyxy without converting to abs_centralized yxyx [-512, 512].

styles.name: MOSS 16-Divisible Canvas Geometry Constraint
styles.krea2Phrase: standard balanced aspect ratio (1024x1024, 896x1152, or 1216x832)
styles.mossCaption: canvas dimensions must strictly divide by 16 (e.g. 1024x1024, 768x1360, 1360x768) to prevent patch alignment errors
styles.mossLayoutHint: Width and height must be exact multiples of 16.
styles.conflictReason: Canvas dimensions that fail to divide by 16 cause tensor mismatch errors.
styles.description: FLUX.2 VAE 4D RoPE patch architecture requires both width and height to be exact integers divisible by 16.
styles.whenToUse: Setting EmptyFlux2LatentImage dimensions in ComfyUI.
styles.antiPatternNote: Never use arbitrary dimensions like 1000x1000 or 750x1334; use 1024x1024 or 768x1360 instead.

styles.name: MOSS Skip Layer Guidance (SLG Layer 22)
styles.krea2Phrase: high-clarity edge sharpness, refined micro-contrast, balanced global lighting
styles.mossCaption: uncond_skip: true, skip_layer: 22, scale: 3.0, step_range: [0.01, 1.0]
styles.conflictReason: SLG should only target layer 22 (or 24/26); other layers cause collapse.
styles.description: Skips transformer layer 22 during unconditional evaluation, dramatically sharpening edges and global composition.
styles.whenToUse: Executing MOSS-Image-Base or SFT in ComfyUI at CFG 3.0 to 5.0.
styles.antiPatternNote: Do not enable on distilled Turbo models running at CFG 1.0.

styles.name: MOSS Base/SFT SFW Negative Conditioning Anchor
styles.krea2Phrase: clean artifact-free rendering without distortions, anatomical errors, or watermarks
styles.mossCaption: worst quality, bad anatomy, watermark, jpeg artifact
styles.conflictReason: Bypassed when CFG is 1.0 on Turbo models.
styles.description: Standard four-token negative anchor for MOSS Base and SFT runs at CFG >= 3.0, filtering artifacts and anatomical deformities.
styles.whenToUse: Populating the negative prompt input on MOSS Base and SFT workflows.
styles.antiPatternNote: Never include prohibited/adult words; keep strictly to technical defect tags.
